notes.title: First 5 Minutes of Gameplay out on YouTube!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=jNtZLLsY9qA;full][/previewyoutube]

The first 5 minutes of gameplay are [b]out![/b] You can watch it above with the little embed player. Go watch it! It's worth you time, we [u]promise[/u]. 

Did you like it? If you did, consider giving the game a wishlist. It sure does help!
Well, that's all. See you later, and have a good day!
